answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by forcing each identity to produce original, peer-graded reasoning every epoch that must coherently weave required terms such as yarrow and plume into a summit of unique insight. This works because an attacker creating many fakes must run distinct high-quality inferences per identity to earn a median grade of 2 or higher; any detected pattern or low score forfeits standing and locked rewards, so the cost per extra head grows with compute time and risk rather than staying flat.
